_comment: OPS-BAK-1: production user-data Docker volumes that the nightly restic backup includes. A volume is backed up only if it matches an include pattern, matches no exclude pattern, and a RUNNING container mounts it. No volume is currently declared in include_exact; HRAM calibration outputs remain excluded by '*calibration_outputs*'. Databases are dumped separately (pg_dump). Secrets volumes are never listed here (secrets come from Proton via sync-secrets). max_total_bytes_per_host stops a host's run before any upload when its selected volumes exceed it (OPS-BAK-1 size gate: basis 13.6 GB + 25 percent).
